ownerMissing.heading: The owner account has not been created yet
ownerMissing.description: The account cannot be created in the browser. Create it with the create-owner command on the server, as described in the README, then reload this page.

enrollment.heading: Set up the authenticator app
enrollment.intro: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator, Aegis or 1Password), then enter the six-digit code the app shows.
enrollment.qrLabel: QR code for the authenticator app
enrollment.manualHint: Add the account in the app by entering this key by hand. Choose a time-based key.
enrollment.codeHint: Six digits. The app changes the code every 30 seconds.

recovery.heading: Save your recovery codes
recovery.intro: Each code works once if you lose access to the authenticator app. They are shown only now and are not kept in a readable form, so save them in a safe place.
recovery.saved: I have saved these codes in a safe place
recovery.lostHeading: The recovery codes are no longer visible
recovery.lostDescription: The codes are shown only once. To get a new set, enter the current code from the authenticator app. The previous set stops working. The app has to show a different code than the one used a moment ago, so wait until it changes.
recovery.reissueHint: Six digits, a different one than the code you entered last.

data.heading: Starting data
data.description: Start with an empty dashboard. You will add your own screens and data later.

preferences.heading: Your preferences
preferences.timezoneHint: For example Europe/Warsaw. Dates and periods are counted in this zone.
